Subject: EdgeSummit partnership opportunity (booth + joint webinar)

Hi Karthik,

Hope youre well — Im Lara from CloudMesh events. Were organizing EdgeSummit SF (Nov 11-12) and would love Redwood to join as a co-exhibitor in a shared booth with a co-branded session/webinar the week before the show. Typical audience: 2,000+ infra and platform engineers (on-prem/edge use cases).

What were proposing: 
- Shared 10x20 island booth (booth cost split)
- $25k MDF contribution to promote the co-hosted webinar and pre-show nurture (CloudMesh covers event ops)
- 60/40 paid split proposal in favor of CloudMesh for booth costs (we handle shipping/logistics)
- Co-hosted webinar the week of Sep 15-19 to seed the pipeline and collect qualified leads

If this sounds interesting I can send an MDF term sheet and draft MOU. Interested in names for the Redwood side who should own this (marketing/partnerships + sales).

Best,
Lara Benson
Head of Events, CloudMesh
lara@cloudmesh.io

Hi Lara — thanks for the invite and context. Im Marissa on Partner Marketing. I pulled together a preliminary MDF term sheet (attached) that reflects Redwoods approach to co-funded events. Key highlights:

- Proposed MDF: $25,000 (split reimbursable for marketing spend with receipts)
- Lead sharing: CSV + HubSpot sync within 72 hours post-event (we require opt-in confirmation)
- Logo and booth placement: equal logo size on shared island unless a paid premium is requested
- MOU: 30-day review + standard indemnity clause; CloudMesh to provide insurance certificate naming Redwood as an additional insured

Could you send last-year webinar conversion metrics and the booth cost estimate so we can confirm the 60/40 split? Im attaching the term sheet and a staffing template — please review and comment.
